cues.use: Opening problem, the joke set-up (minor sitcom, theme on theremin)
Explaining, the idea, how it works (rhodes, theme on vibes)
Grinding, posting every day, chaos (fast arps, theme on xylophone)
Ads, sales, prices, the casino of paid traffic (swing + brass, theme on muted brass)
Awkward, sneaky, the secret, the mistake (pizzicato + tuba, theme on clarinet)
The drop, bad news, the algorithm (strings + heartbeat, theme slowed on theremin)
The turn, the solution (major folk, theme on nylon guitar)
Community, win, CTA bed (major sitcom, theme on theremin)

leitmotifs.use: Dex (narrator): the theme head on theremin, dry and knowing
Tony (hero): the head on tuba, a proud oom-pah march
Tony's Mom: the head as a music box (vibes), sweet and mischievous

stings.use: Sonic logo: the head on brass + sparkle (brand appears)
Series bumper / scene transition: pizzicato run (one per video, same every time)
CTA / end card: theme head in major + warm pad
Button on the last joke: theremin ta-daa
